name: kernels
description: 13 vector/FP kernels, portable C vs RVV 1.0 intrinsics, each checked bit for bit against a scalar reference and a host KAT
units: calls of the region's kernel (cycles/iteration = cycles per call)
expect: KERNEL vadd_i32 CHECK OK elem=1024 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL vadd_i64 CHECK OK elem=512 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL daxpy CHECK OK elem=512 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL saxpy CHECK OK elem=1024 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL ddot CHECK OK elem=512 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL idot_i32 CHECK OK elem=1024 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL memcpy CHECK OK byte=4096 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL memset CHECK OK byte=4096 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL dgemm CHECK OK mac=32768 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL sgemm CHECK OK mac=32768 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL fir_f32 CHECK OK mac=16384 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL mac_i8 CHECK OK mac=4096 iterations={iterations}
KERNEL mac_i16 CHECK OK mac=2048 iterations={iterations}

scalar.description: C kernels for the scalar ISA (-march=rv64gc_zba_zbb_zbc_zbs_zcb_zicond_zbkb_zbkx_zkne_zknd_zknh, -O2): C = scalar baseline

autovec.description: C kernels with the SDK -march (with V) at -O3: C = GCC 16 auto-vectorization (at -O2 it vectorizes only the FIR inner loop)

kernels.name: daxpy
kernels.what: y[i] += a * x[i], fp64, n = 512 (in place)

kernels.name: saxpy
kernels.what: y[i] += a * x[i], fp32, n = 1024 (in place)

kernels.name: idot_i32
kernels.what: sum x[i] * y[i], int32 x int32 -> int64, n = 1024

kernels.name: memcpy
kernels.what: copy 4096 bytes, 8-byte aligned (C: SDK memcpy; RVV: e64; RVV-e8: e8)

kernels.name: memset
kernels.what: fill 4096 bytes, 8-byte aligned (C: SDK memset; RVV: e64; RVV-e8: e8)

kernels.name: dgemm
kernels.what: C = A B, 32 x 32 fp64, row-major

kernels.name: sgemm
kernels.what: C = A B, 32 x 32 fp32, row-major

kernels.name: fir_f32
kernels.what: y[i] = sum h[k] x[i+k], fp32, 1024 outputs x 16 taps

kernels.name: mac_i8
kernels.what: sum x[i] * y[i], int8 x int8 -> int32 (RVV: vwmul + vwadd.wv), n = 4096

kernels.name: mac_i16
kernels.what: sum x[i] * y[i], int16 x int16 -> int32 (RVV: vwmacc), n = 2048
